content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ICMR Young Professional-II Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for ICMR Young Professional-II Recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the ICMR Young Professional-II position is scheduled for 02 September 2026. Candidates should ensure they reach the venue on time with all necessary documents.

faq.question: Q2. What is the eligibility criteria for the Young Professional-II post at ICMR?
faq.answer: To be eligible, candidates must have a Post Graduate degree in Biostatistics, Statistics, Demography, Population Studies, Public Health, or Medical Sociology with at least 55% marks and one year of post-qualification experience.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Young Professional-II post is 40 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per ICMR and DoPT guidelines.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Young Professional-II position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 42,000.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Young Professional-II post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Young Professional-II post announced by ICMR.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee required for this recruitment. Candidates from all categories (General, OBC, SC, ST) are exempt from paying any fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the ICMR Young Professional-II recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will primarily involve a Walk-in Interview. However, a Written Test may be conducted if the number of candidates exceeds 30.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, self-attested photocopies of these documents, and recent passport-size photographs. This includes ID proof, educational certificates, and experience certificates.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted in New Delhi, Delhi. The exact venue details will be available in the official notification.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No, the Young Professional-II position at ICMR is a contractual role. The duration and terms of the contract will be as per the official notification.
